reason: $89 a month is about a tenth of what I earn in a year, and my clients already write to me in Telegram. I am not paying that for something nobody I know uses yet.
objection: I would have to move all my clients and retrain my staff, and only 1 to 5 companies pay for it. No other shop owner I know uses it, so I would be the test case.
would_change_my_mind: A shop owner I know and trust tells me he uses it and it saves him time, plus a much lower price (around $15 to $20) and help moving my clients over from Telegram.
